channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Electric pumps have taken the cycling world by storm... but I'm not convinced
item.description: Arguably 2025's biggest bike tech trend, electric pumps take the effort out of tyre inflation. That's all well and good, but I still reckon regular pumps are better

item.title: Segway is making a new e-bike: teaser of mysterious Myon shows rear hub motor and RearView Radar technology
item.description: He’s behind you! The advanced RearView Radar should give a fuller picture of incoming traffic on Segway's latest two-wheeled project

item.title: Trek recalls 700 electric road and gravel bikes due to loose chainrings, as brand tells customers to stop riding immediately
item.description: The American company says the chainring bolts were “not tightened to specification during assembly”, causing them to loosen and potentially fall off the bike, creating a crash risk

item.title: Making an affordable race bike for 2026 is harder than you think — but there are some smart ways you can save with compromising performance
item.description: Liam tries to build a go-faster road bike for group rides and the occasional race

item.title: Could this open-source TT rider model transform cycling aerodynamics? Plus Islabikes makes a mini comeback, 4iiii power meters now come fitted on numerous Cube bikes + more
item.description: All the best new tech we've spotted this week, including cool stuff from Cube, Islabikes, SKS, Muc-Off and more

item.title: “Gear restrictions are a no-brainer”: Cadel Evans and Stuart O’Grady on cycling’s safety debate, how the sport has changed, protests, and why fans should “just enjoy watching Pogačar’s greatness”
item.description: The 2011 Tour de France winner and the 2007 Paris-Roubaix conqueror join the road.cc Podcast to discuss their shifting perspectives on the sport since retiring and why Tadej Pogačar isn’t boring, he’s just a “freak”

item.title: Gorewear Swiftride Thermo Bib Tights Women
item.description: Warm and soft for short to mid-distance rides but the loose fit and no weather protection limits all-conditions performance 7/10

item.title: “People are not one thing or another”: Labour transport chief condemns “shameful” Tory cycling culture wars – but campaigners slam government active travel ‘cuts’ while “wasting billions on big road schemes”
item.description: The Transport Action Network say a real term funding cut of 36% since 2021-22 shows Labour are not "serious about growth and the NHS"

item.title: Ribble Ultra-Grit Apex XPLR AXS
item.description: Stiff and efficient gravel racer, but lacking the ride quality and rider interaction of some rivals 7/10

item.title: “The OG of longtail e-cargo bikes”: check out the Tern GSD
item.description: With Tern’s electric cargo bikes racking up over a million miles delivering around New York City, here’s why the brand’s GSD – the OG longtail – remains the benchmark if you're thinking about ditching a car
